post.title: How Leicester City Went from Champions to League One in a Decade

tweets.text:
From 5000-1 Champions to League One

2016: Premier League title. 2026: League One. In less than a decade, Leicester went from football's greatest miracle to one of its steepest falls.

A data-driven autopsy. Thread 🧵

The 2015–16 title squad was worth €161M — roughly half the league average of €210M.

Vardy came free. Kanté cost €9M. Mahrez cost €500K.

They didn't buy the title. They found it.

From 2017, every window followed the same pattern: the talent that left was worth more than the talent that arrived.

The squad ceiling kept dropping, one sale at a time.

Here's the twist: Leicester were net buyers in most windows. They spent more in fees than they received.

But there was no second Kanté for €9M. No second Mahrez for €500K.

The money was spent. The quality wasn't there.

Compare the title season (2015–16) to the Championship campaign (2025–26).

Summer departures MV: €34M → €156M.

After the 2025 relegation, €156M of talent walked out the door — replaced by €46M of arrivals.

It wasn't just that the talent left. It's where it landed.

Maguire → Man United. Mahrez → Man City. Chilwell & Fofana → Chelsea. Maddison → Tottenham.

~€300M to direct Top-6 rivals.

Since the 2016 title, Leicester exported over €1 billion in player market value.

Chelsea alone absorbed €139M. Add Tottenham, City and United and the Top 6 took 28% of every elite player who left.

Maguire: €8M → €50M (+525%). Maddison: €10M → €60M (+500%). Kanté: €4.5M → €20M in one season.

Each row is a player. The dot on the right is their value when they left.

Leicester had an extraordinary eye for talent. They just had to keep selling it.

The replacements told the opposite story.

Bertrand: €8M in, €0.8M out. Evans: €15M in, €2M out. Praet: €24M in, €4M out.

16 of 38 players left out of contract — Tielemans (€25M), Söyüncü (€15M), Iheanacho (€12M). All for free.

Leicester's fall is not a story of bad luck.

It's a story of a scouting model that couldn't be repeated — and fees spent on players who declined rather than flourished.

Finding lightning once is genius. Bottling it is the hard part.

Full analysis 👉 https://econofutbol.github.io/econofutbol/leicester-collapse
